description.en: Shiga Prefecture is an inland prefecture of Japan in the Kansai region of Honshu. Shiga Prefecture has a population of 1,398,972 as of 1 February 2025 and has a geographic area of 4,017 km2 .
description.zh-CN: 滋賀縣是日本近畿地方的縣，為日本8個無海岸線的內陸縣份之一，首府位於大津市。滋賀縣是日本面積第10小的縣份，在內陸縣份中面積僅大於埼玉縣。
